title: Universal quasi-tree resolutions of powers of square-free monomial ideals
author: Cooper, Susan M.; El Khoury, Sabine; Faridi, Sara; Mayes-Tang, Sarah; Morey, Susan; Şega, Liana M.; Spiroff, Sandra
work: Simplicial resolutions of powers of square-free monomial ideals

primary_locator.required_new_core: complete two-layer universal quasi-tree facets and leaf-order proof, divisibility-pruned complex definition, square-free exponent/divisibility lemmas and lcm-induced connectivity/minimal-degree contradiction source658--1993

difficulty_reason: The authors build a universal two-layer quasi-tree and a divisibility-pruned subcomplex, then prove every lcm-induced subcomplex is connected through a carefully constructed base vertex. The square-free divisibility and minimal-degree contradiction close the uniform resolution theorem; the core connectivity construction goes beyond a routine cellular-resolution criterion.
